Name: bZoneOk
Comment: FALSE freezes the active job (zone hold)

Name: rVelScale
Comment: R-05b collision guard: live velocity scale [0.1..1], 1.0 = full speed

Name: ioaBelt
Comment: FW-1: belt encoder axes, one per feed (native tracking) 1..GC_FEEDS

Name: m_bJobVld
Comment: TRUE while a job is admitted and not finished

Name: m_uiRetry
Comment: Verification retry counter for the current pick

Name: m_eStPrev
Comment: State of the previous cycle (edge detection)

Name: m_eStPaused
Comment: State saved when the operator paused the robot

Name: m_bResumeReq
Comment: Resume request latch from the HMI

Name: m_bDryRun
Comment: Dry-run mode: motions simulated, I/O inhibited

Name: m_iTool
Comment: Active tool of the current item

Name: m_bSync
Comment: TRUE while the job runs as one synchronized cluster descent

Name: m_bRegrip
Comment: TRUE while a single failed cup is being re-gripped individually

Name: m_bEvalArm
Comment: TRUE when GripEval must freeze the per-cup picture (one-shot arm, prevents a stale re-freeze after each individual re-grip)

Name: m_bSyncPlaceRun
Comment: TRUE while the synchronized place leg is executing

Name: m_bSyncPlaceDone
Comment: TRUE after the synchronized place attempt (never retried as sync)

Name: m_bSyncPlaceOk
Comment: Result of the last synchronized place geometry fit

Name: m_bTrkReq
Comment: TRUE when the armed tracked move runs native (mode on AND feed wired, plus the per-feed place selector on the place side, v1.4)

Name: m_bTrkPl
Comment: v1.4: TRUE = the current place item runs the native tracked place (session on the outfeed belt). Set by CompPlaceTargets, cleared by the synchronized place path (cluster place stays static by design).

Name: m_stBeltOrg
Comment: Belt CS origin passed to the adapter session (world/MCS)

Name: m_stObjBelt
Comment: Product pose in the belt CS at capture (session anchor)

Name: m_rSyncDist
Comment: Sync-in conveyor distance passed to the session [mm]

Name: m_iFeedNow
Comment: Pick feed of the current item (belt axis index, always in range)

Name: m_stTargetBelt
Comment: Belt-frame (PCS) target of the armed tracked move
